title: The ALPINE-ALMA [CII] survey. Circumgalactic medium pollution and gas mixing by tidal stripping in a merging system at z ∼ 4.57
question: Does a merging galaxy system at z~4.57 host extended [CII] emission on circumgalactic scales, and does it arise from tidal stripping, outflows or faint satellites?

data.sensitivity: 14 mJy/beam per 25 km/s channel; 60 uJy/beam continuum

what.value: M* and SFR of C15_705574 from COSMOS2015

evidence.quote: Using the $L_{\rm [CII]}-M_{\rm gas}$ relation calibrated by (cite: Zanella2018)
typical mass outflow rates of $\dot{M}_{\rm out} \sim 30 ~ {\rm M_\odot ~ yr^{-1}}$ (as measured by (cite: Ginolfi2020)

recipe.method: tclean MFS continuum; uvcontsub then cube with natural weighting, 25 km/s channels

recipe.goal: Extract spectra and moment maps of #A and #B
recipe.method: 1'' diameter aperture spectra, Gaussian model, collapse cube over f_cen±sigma_G, fit 2D Gaussian to maps, re-extract with FWHM ellipses

recipe.goal: Map total [CII] structure and PV diagrams
recipe.method: velocity-integrated map over [-500,+500] km/s about z_ref=4.570; PV diagrams along A-B axis and orthogonal
compare spectrum within 1-sigma contour of total map with sum of the four galaxy spectra
outflow timescale from Zanella2018 gas mass and Mdot_out~30; UV diffuse SFR vs L_[CII]-SFR relations
assumptions: no re-accretion; both #A and #B drive outflows

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels used for continuum and uvcontsub
Gaussian fit and aperture details for spectra and uncertainty estimation
Conversion from flux to L_[CII] and L_[CII]-SFR relation parameters
Aperture/contour used for the total spectrum (1-sigma contour definition and noise)
PV diagram slit widths and angles
missing_for_reproduction: Exact apertures and contour for total spectrum
DEIMOS and HST F160W data unpublished (in prep.)
score_reason: Public ALMA data and clear imaging settings, but spectral extraction details and some ancillary data are not provided.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALPINE data, numeric luminosities, and a moderately complete recipe.
